key_insight: Modality Forcing turns a text-to-image model into a joint image-depth generator with a simple post-training recipe. It leverages the spatial priors already inside modern generative models, so high-quality geometry-aware scene generation can be learned from sparse depth data instead of expensive dense supervision.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the difficulty of generating realistic spatial scenes while preserving geometry, perspective, and relative scale. Existing methods often need dense depth labels and complicated training pipelines, making them hard to scale.
method: Start with a single diffusion transformer (DiT) pretrained for text-to-image generation.
Apply a simple post-training procedure that forces the model to generate both image and depth modalities together.
Train using sparse depth data, avoiding the need for dense depth supervision and complex multi-stage recipes.
impact: This makes spatially aware generative modeling more practical and scalable for AI practitioners. It could simplify building models for scene understanding, 3D-aware generation, robotics, and synthetic data creation.

paper_title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
paper_authors: Bardienus Pieter Duisterhof, Deva Ramanan, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Justin Johnson, Keunhong Park
